Finding: Malware was detected by Windows Defender.
ImmediateAction: Quarantine any files identified in Defender detections or suspicious drop locations. Do not execute.
FollowUp: Enable Defender Tamper Protection organization-wide to prevent AV from being disabled without cloud authorization.

Finding: Defender failed to remove a detected threat, indicating active malware may still be present.
ImmediateAction: Malware remediation failed. Do not reboot. Conduct offline analysis or engage IR support to remove the active threat.
FollowUp: Enable Defender Tamper Protection organization-wide to prevent AV from being disabled without cloud authorization.

Finding: Suspicious behavior was blocked by Defender's behavior monitoring.
ImmediateAction: Acquire a memory image before rebooting. volatile artifacts will be lost on restart.
FollowUp: Evaluate application whitelisting (e.g., AppLocker or WDAC) to restrict unauthorized execution.

Finding: Controlled Folder Access was triggered, consistent with a ransomware attempt targeting protected directories.
ImmediateAction: Verify no files were encrypted prior to the Controlled Folder Access block. Audit all protected directories.
FollowUp: Verify backup integrity and ensure offline or immutable backups are available for all critical data.

Finding: Exploit Protection blocked an execution attempt, indicating an active exploit was used against this host.
ImmediateAction: A process injection or exploit was detected. Audit all running processes for signs of compromise and terminate suspicious ones.
FollowUp: Review patch status of all software on this host and prioritize remediation of known exploited vulnerabilities.

Finding: An Advanced Persistent Threat was identified by Defender, indicating a sophisticated, targeted attack.

Finding: Malicious PowerShell or script activity was detected and blocked by Defender.
ImmediateAction: Review and disable PowerShell remoting and scripting on this host until the investigation is complete.
FollowUp: Enforce PowerShell Constrained Language Mode and enable Script Block Logging across the environment.

Finding: Windows Defender real-time protection was disabled. This is a primary defense evasion technique used by malware to prevent detection during or after installation.
ImmediateAction: Re-enable Windows Defender real-time protection immediately and run a full scan.
FollowUp: Enable Defender Tamper Protection organization-wide to prevent AV from being disabled without cloud authorization.

Finding: Windows Defender configuration was changed. Attackers modify Defender settings to reduce detection coverage. Common changes include adding exclusions for malware drop paths or disabling archive and script scanning.
ImmediateAction: Review all recent Defender configuration changes via Event Viewer and revert unauthorized modifications.; Audit exclusion paths. Remove any entries covering Temp, Public, or ProgramData directories.
FollowUp: Enable Defender Tamper Protection organization-wide to prevent AV from being disabled without cloud authorization.; Consider alerting on all Defender configuration change events in your SIEM.

Finding: Windows Defender Tamper Protection was disabled or targeted, removing endpoint protection prior to or during the attack.
ImmediateAction: Re-enable Windows Defender Tamper Protection and verify AV is fully operational.
FollowUp: Enable Defender Tamper Protection organization-wide to prevent AV from being disabled without cloud authorization.

Finding: A malicious outbound network connection was blocked by Defender Network Protection.
ImmediateAction: Block identified C2 IPs/domains at the perimeter firewall and review network logs for lateral spread.
FollowUp: Review and tighten egress firewall rules. Block known C2 ports (4444, 1337, 9001, 9050) and known malicious domains identified in logs.

ImmediateAction: Export all remaining event logs and Defender detection history immediately to prevent further evidence loss.
FollowUp: Configure log forwarding to a centralized SIEM or remote syslog server to prevent local log tampering.
